Scope and evidence

Every populated cell was captured from every supplied worksheet, including notes, helper cells, formulas and cached errors. Styled empty cells are counted in Source coverage. Rule-based checks cover explicit criteria, dictionary consistency, currency-column differences, formulas, maturity boundaries, absent balance types and exact GL segment bridges. An unflagged cell is not a certificate of semantic correctness.
